experiments.title: Operation-local and failed-RPC metrics
experiments.hypothesis: Accurate operation-local and terminal failure metrics can be added without changing runtime behavior or leaking provider diagnostics.
acceptance: successful RPC metrics remain backward-readable
failed RPCs emit one sanitized terminal metric with outcome and bounded failure phase/class
run metrics expose operation-local Pi RPC values without removing cumulative observability
provider_error mock preserves secret redaction
tests cover initial plus continuation scope

experiments.title: Effective phase tool surface
experiments.hypothesis: Runtime can report the actual phase-scoped registered tool count and schema bytes, making phase A/B experiments measurable without changing default routing.
acceptance: default phase=all behavior is unchanged
metrics distinguish profile count from effective phase count
metrics record phase and serialized schema-byte estimate or exact runtime value
existing profile/phase contract tests pass
no evidence or publication gate changes

experiments.title: Persistent Pi process prototype
experiments.hypothesis: Reusing one Pi child for initial plus continuation can remove repeated process startup while preserving session semantics and bounded waits.
acceptance: prototype is opt-in or test-only; default behavior remains unchanged
one child process can serve initial plus continuation in a deterministic mock
bounded timeout and provider-error behavior still fail closed
measure process launch count and E2E delta against baseline
no provider-specific dependency

experiments.title: Typed Stage Packet prototype
experiments.hypothesis: A content-addressed Stage Packet can reduce boundary payload by at least 80% while fail-closed resolving existing IR refs and hashes.
acceptance: packet contains refs, hashes, reason codes, allowed scope, and schema version
tampered or missing referenced artifact fails closed
no duplicate FactGraph/ClaimGraph/StoryGraph state is introduced
migration fixture demonstrates >=80% serialized boundary-byte reduction
packet does not embed full facts/claims/evidence bodies

experiments.title: Sparse macro checkpoint controller
experiments.hypothesis: An opt-in RESEARCH/DESIGN/PUBLISH controller can express deterministic boundaries around existing IR while leaving open semantic decisions to Pi.
acceptance: prototype is opt-in; default investigate path is unchanged
only three macro checkpoints are introduced
checkpoint events include scope, elapsed time, reason codes, and pass/fail
existing evidence/verification/completion gates remain authoritative
no generic new RunState or parallel memory system
mock A/B reports RPC count, prompt bytes, retries, and E2E
